SELECT person.faculty_id, person.faculty_name, person.major_id, person.major_name, COUNT(*) AS participant_count FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN COALESCE(department.parent_id, 0) = 0 THEN department.department_id ELSE faculty.department_id END AS faculty_id, CASE WHEN COALESCE(department.parent_id, 0) = 0 THEN department.title ELSE faculty.title END AS faculty_name, CASE WHEN department.parent_id > 0 THEN department.department_id ELSE NULL END AS major_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(r.major), ''), CASE WHEN department.parent_id > 0 THEN department.title ELSE NULL END) AS major_name FROM ( SELECT MIN(record_id) AS record_id FROM gkzh_zycck_record WHERE school_id = #{schoolId} AND instance_id = #{instanceId} AND game_type = 'zycck'
AND status = 'finished' AND (status IS NULL OR status <> 'finished') AND stage = 'activity_feedback' AND (status IS NULL OR status <> 'finished') AND (stage IS NULL OR stage <> 'activity_feedback')
AND scan_time >= #{startTime} AND scan_time < #{endExclusive} GROUP BY user_id ) first_record JOIN gkzh_zycck_record r ON r.record_id = first_record.record_id
LEFT JOIN gkzh_student student ON student.student_id = COALESCE( (SELECT s.student_id FROM gkzh_student s WHERE s.student_id = r.student_id AND s.user_id = r.user_id AND s.school_id = r.school_id AND s.del_flag = '0'), (SELECT s.student_id FROM gkzh_student s WHERE s.user_id = r.user_id AND s.school_id = r.school_id AND s.del_flag = '0' ORDER BY s.student_id LIMIT 1)) LEFT JOIN gkzh_school_department department ON department.department_id = COALESCE(r.department_id, student.department_id) AND department.school_id = r.school_id LEFT JOIN gkzh_school_department faculty ON faculty.department_id = department.parent_id AND faculty.school_id = r.school_id ) person GROUP BY person.faculty_id, person.faculty_name, person.major_id, person.major_name ORDER BY person.faculty_name, person.major_name, person.faculty_id, person.major_id
